mcqs.question: In the Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2025, which city was ranked among the top three cleanest-air cities for the second consecutive year and was the only city from Gujarat in the top ranks?
mcqs.explanation: Surat was among the top three cleanest-air cities in the Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2025 for the second consecutive year and was the only city from Gujarat in the top ranks. Guntur was ranked sixth nationally in the category for cities with a population below 10 lakh.
